answer: Sequential physical-presence attestation: each identity must periodically solve a challenge at a registered physical site, and the delta between consecutive check-ins is capped so identities can't be batched remotely. Sites are seeded on an island or lagoon where a single operator cannot occupy two terminals in the same time window, since each terminal signs with hardware whose clock drifts sync to a local beacon. An attacker pays one human-hour and one travel leg per identity per period, making N identities cost N times that, not a shared script run.
